﻿Stage37 HOSTILE AUDIT — M3-T11-097 through M3-T11-100


HOSTILE_AUDIT=PASS
AUDITED_CARDS=M3-T11-097,M3-T11-098,M3-T11-099,M3-T11-100
AUDIT_GROUPS=M3-T11-097->M3-T11-098 dependency chain; M3-T11-099 independent; M3-T11-100 independent
PRIOR_AUDITED_FRONTIER=M3-T11-096
LATEST_AUDITED_RESEARCH_CARD=M3-T11-100
GITHUB_ACCESSED=false


1. Executive verdict


All four provisional cards survive hostile audit.


Promoted:
- M3-T11-097: rational 2-torsion translation exchanges the two visible M_rel^2 branch-depth factors of theta; duplication produces an exact rational square; ordinary rational-T Kummer iteration cannot recover the fresh M_rel factor.
- M3-T11-098: the residual split-dual 2-Kummer brackets factor into complete squares over K=Q(sqrt(theta)); the full ordinary split dual 2-Kummer tuple is, up to ordering, (1,[-N_0],[-N_0]), including the split-torsion special-value cases.
- M3-T11-099: the Section-48 residual interior character is exactly a prescribed Legendre sign of the single S-numerator s; for q_int equal to the squarefree radical of the interior support, the exact admissible unit density is 2^(-omega(q_int)).
- M3-T11-100: after forced conductor normalization, the interior endpoint square equation is a p-adic unit equation whose mod-p squareclass is exactly the M3-T11-099 selector; odd-prime Hensel lifting adds no deeper p-adic thinning.


Not promoted:
M3_T11_DENOMINATOR_EXTREME_SUPPORT_DEFICIT_PROVED=false
M3_T11_PRIMARY_GATE_CLOSED=false
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false


No endpoint theorem and no Perfect Cuboid existence/nonexistence credit are obtained.


2. Dependency and measure audit — PASS


M3-T11-097 depends only on hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-090 through M3-T11-096.
M3-T11-098 depends on M3-T11-097 plus hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-096 and is audited here as one dependency chain with 097.
M3-T11-099 is independent of 097/098 and uses hostile-audit-passed Section 35, Section 48, and M3-T11-040.
M3-T11-100 is likewise independent of 097/098 and logically does not require 099; 099 is only a consistency cross-check.


All four cards remain on the same exact physical R<=B population. No population, height, field, quotient, or multiplicity change is charged as a saving.


3. M3-T11-097 — PASS


Use
E_theta^-: Z^2=U*(U^2+(9+4*theta)*U+4*theta),
U=-A,
A=v+1,
q=Z/A.


Substitution gives exactly
q^2=9+4*theta-A-4*theta/A,
hence
A^2-(9+4*theta-q^2)*A+4*theta=0.


For T=(0,0), the standard group law on y^2=x*(x^2+a*x+b) gives
U(P+T)=b/U(P),
Z(P+T)=-b*Z/U(P)^2.
With b=4*theta and A=-U:
A(P+T)=4*theta/A(P),
q(P+T)=-q(P).
Thus the two A-roots are exactly the T-translate pair and have product 4*theta.


On full-S:
A=M^2*kappa,
theta=M^4*Theta,
so
kappa_T=4*Theta/kappa.
Using the audited M3-T11-094 formulas,
kappa_T=Psi_theta/(a^2*s^2),
kappa*kappa_T=4*Theta.
The two M^2 depth factors are therefore one involutive structure and cannot be double charged.


The duplication identity is exact:
U(2P)=((U^2-4*theta)/(2*Z))^2.
Thus the apparent doubled fourth-power depth is an exact rational square and supplies no independent squareclass event.


The rational-T Kummer map is
delta_T(P)=[U(P)].
Since
U=-(v+1)=-M^2*N_0/b^2,
delta_T(P)=[-N_0].
As delta_T is a homomorphism modulo 2E,
delta_T(nP)=[-N_0] for odd n and 1 for even n.
Ordinary multiplication-by-n Kummer iteration cannot restore the fresh M factor.


The split-dual formulas in 097 also check exactly:
q^2-alpha_+
=-4*M^2*(eta+3*omega-M^2*omega^2+M^2*Theta),
q^2-alpha_-
=4*M^2*(eta-3*omega+M^2*omega^2-M^2*Theta).
At this stage only the forced M^2 square factor is removed; 097 correctly leaves the residual brackets to 098.


Promoted:
M3_T11_097_HOSTILE_AUDIT=PASS
M3_T11_THETA_T_TRANSLATION_BRANCH_DEPTH_INVOLUTION=true
M3_T11_THETA_BRANCH_DEPTH_PRODUCT_4THETA=true
M3_T11_THETA_DUPLICATION_DEPTH_EXACT_SQUARE=true
M3_T11_RATIONAL_T_KUMMER_ITERATES_FRESH_CONDUCTOR_VISIBLE=false


4. M3-T11-098 — PASS


Put m=M^2 and retain the audited identity
Theta=kappa*(kappa-12*omega+4*m*omega^2)/(4*v),
v=m*kappa-1.


Direct exact simplification gives
3*omega-m*omega^2+m*Theta
=kappa/2+(4*Theta-kappa^2)/(4*kappa).


With eta^2=Theta:
B_+=(eta+kappa/2)^2/kappa,
B_-=-(eta-kappa/2)^2/kappa.


Hence
q^2-alpha_+
=-(4*M^2/kappa)*(eta+kappa/2)^2,
q^2-alpha_-
=-(4*M^2/kappa)*(eta-kappa/2)^2.


For nonzero coordinates,
[q^2-alpha_+]=[q^2-alpha_-]=[-1/kappa]=[-N_0]
in K*/K*^2, because kappa=N_0/b^2.
Also [Xp]=[q^2]=1.
Thus the ordinary split dual 2-Kummer tuple is
(1,[-N_0],[-N_0])
up to ordering.


The torsion special cases are also correct.
If eta=kappa/2 then q^2=alpha_- and
alpha_--alpha_+=-4*M^2*kappa.
If eta=-kappa/2 then q^2=alpha_+ and
alpha_+-alpha_-=-4*M^2*kappa.
Under the standard full-2-descent special-value convention, the zero coordinate is replaced by the product of root differences; the remaining q^2 factor is a square, so the special coordinate again has class [-kappa]=[-N_0].


Therefore the residual split-2-Kummer classes left open by 097 contain no new ordinary Kummer squareclass information.


Promoted:
M3_T11_098_HOSTILE_AUDIT=PASS
M3_T11_DUAL_SPLIT_2KUMMER_BRACKETS_COMPLETE_SQUARE=true
M3_T11_DUAL_SPLIT_2KUMMER_RESIDUAL_CLASSES_OPEN=false
M3_T11_DUAL_SPLIT_2KUMMER_CLASSES_MINUS_N0=true
M3_T11_DUAL_SPLIT_2KUMMER_TORSION_SPECIAL_VALUE_MINUS_N0=true
M3_T11_FULL_SPLIT_2KUMMER_NEW_SAVING=false


5. M3-T11-099 — PASS


For an interior fresh prime p^lambda with 0<c_p<2*lambda, put
k_p=2*lambda-c_p,
t=p^k_p*tau_p,
N_u=p^(2*lambda+c_p)*nu_p.


The hostile-audit-passed Section-35 identity gives
P=v_1*v_2*v_3
=4*u^2*S/(1+u^2)
=4*a^2*s/(t*N_u).


Since
k_p+(2*lambda+c_p)=4*lambda,
the Section-48 unit
Pi_p=p^(4*lambda)*P
is exactly
Pi_p=4*a^2*s/(tau_p*nu_p).


At the oriented Gaussian root
a==rho*b mod p,
rho^2==-1 mod p,
one has a^2==-b^2 mod p, so
-rho*Pi_p
==4*rho*b^2*s/(tau_p*nu_p) mod p.


Because 4*b^2 is a nonzero square and a quadratic character has the same value on a unit and its inverse:
chi_p(-rho*Pi_p)
=chi_p(rho*tau_p*nu_p)*chi_p(s).


Thus the physical selector is exactly
chi_p(s)=chi_p(rho*tau_p*nu_p).


For
q_int=product_{p interior} p,
with fixed auxiliary signs epsilon_p, each p admits exactly (p-1)/2 nonzero s-classes. CRT therefore gives exactly
phi(q_int)/2^omega(q_int)
admissible unit classes, and
1_select(s)
=2^(-omega(q_int))*product_{p|q_int}(1+epsilon_p*chi_p(s)).


Hence selector-only equidistribution has an unavoidable principal relative density 2^(-omega(q_int)). Uniformly this is q_int^(-o(1)) in the worst case, and equals 1/2 when q_int is prime. Cancellation of nonprincipal character sums alone cannot produce a uniform q_int^(-delta) saving.


Promoted:
M3_T11_099_HOSTILE_AUDIT=PASS
M3_T11_INTERIOR_CHARACTER_SINGLE_S_NUMERATOR=true
M3_T11_INTERIOR_CHARACTER_CRT_EXACT_ACCEPTANCE=true
M3_T11_INTERIOR_CHARACTER_EQUIDISTRIBUTION_ONLY_FIXED_POWER=false
M3_T11_INTERIOR_CHARACTER_GENERIC_DISPERSION_ATTACK_RETIRED=true
M3_T11_INTERIOR_CHARACTER_ENDPOINT_CORRELATION_OPEN=true


6. M3-T11-100 — PASS


Section 48 gives
W^2=-N_u*Phi
and, for an interior prime,
v_p(Phi)=k_p.


Define
Phi_hat_p=Phi/p^k_p,
W_hat_p=W/p^(2*lambda).
Since
(2*lambda+c_p)+k_p=4*lambda,
one gets exactly
W_hat_p^2=-nu_p*Phi_hat_p,
with all displayed factors p-adic units.


Use the audited exact division identity
Phi
=N_u*(s^4+44*s^2*t^2-16*t^4)-16*b*t*H,
H=a*s^3+3*b*s^2*t-3*a*s*t^2-b*t^3,
and
H==b*rho*(s-rho*t)^3 mod p.


Because k_p>0, p|t and p does not divide s, so
H==b*rho*s^3 mod p.


After division by p^k_p, the first N_u term retains valuation
(2*lambda+c_p)-k_p=2*c_p>=2,
hence vanishes mod p.
Therefore
Phi_hat_p
==-16*b^2*rho*tau_p*s^3 mod p,
and
W_hat_p^2
==16*b^2*rho*tau_p*nu_p*s^3 mod p.


Removing the nonzero square 16*b^2*s^2 gives exactly
chi_p(s)=chi_p(rho*tau_p*nu_p),
the same selector as 099.


For odd p, a p-adic unit is a square iff its residue mod p is a square. Any nonzero root mod p has derivative 2*w a p-adic unit and lifts uniquely along each sign. Therefore every accepted mod-p s-class has no further square-solvability obstruction at p^2,p^3,... .


For fixed auxiliary local unit data and any h>=1, exactly
phi(p^h)/2
unit s-classes modulo p^h are accepted, each with exactly two W_hat_p roots. Across a finite interior-prime set and arbitrary precisions, CRT preserves exact relative density
2^(-omega(q_int)).


Thus the same local normalized endpoint square equation has no hidden higher-p-adic saving beyond the first-residue selector.


Promoted:
M3_T11_100_HOSTILE_AUDIT=PASS
M3_T11_INTERIOR_NORMALIZED_SQUARE_HENSEL_SATURATED=true
M3_T11_INTERIOR_HIGHER_PADIC_SELECTOR_GAIN=false
M3_T11_INTERIOR_ENDPOINT_SQUARE_LOCAL_REFINEMENT_RETIRED=true
M3_T11_INTERIOR_CHARACTER_ENDPOINT_GLOBAL_CORRELATION_OPEN=true


7. Canonical route consequence


The following independent attacks are now audited-retired:
- ordinary rational-T Kummer iteration as a fresh M_rel detector;
- ordinary split dual 2-Kummer residual brackets;
- selector-only interior-character Burgess/large-sieve/equidistribution;
- deeper p-adic refinement of the same Section-48 interior square equation.


The surviving legal frontier is:
ThetaFourthPowerMovingSupportBeyondKummer
or
InteriorCharacterCrossPrimeEndpointCorrelation.


Any continuation must introduce genuinely new global/non-Kummer information, not another presentation of the audited theta/Kummer identities or the Hensel-saturated local selector.

﻿Stage37 HOSTILE AUDIT — M3-T11-081 and M3-T11-082


HOSTILE_AUDIT=PASS
AUDITED_CARDS=M3-T11-081,M3-T11-082
CURRENT_LATEST_AUDITED_RESEARCH_CARD=M3-T11-096
AUDIT_SCOPE=x=-1/8 Sophie-Germain residual-kernel router, distinguished congruent-number point, standard Weierstrass denominator root, exact naive x-height window, and no-double-charge relation between 081 and 082.
GITHUB_ACCESSED=false


1. Executive verdict


M3-T11-081: PASS.
M3-T11-082: PASS.


This closes historical audit debt only. It does not move the live research frontier backward from M3-T11-096 and does not change NEXT_RESEARCH_CARD_ID=M3-T11-097.


Promoted exact structure:
- F(r,s)=r^4+4*s^4=D*(epsilon*M_rel*h)^2 on the exact x=-1/8 physical carrier;
- the explicit non-2-torsion point on E_D:y^2=x^3-D^2*x;
- every realized D lies in the corresponding distinguished negative-square 2-descent/congruent-number class;
- the same point written in primitive physical coordinates is P_D=(-b^2/q^2,a*b*c/q^3), q=M_rel*h;
- q is exactly the standard denominator root in the integral model;
- M_rel divides that standard denominator root;
- H_x(P_D)=max(b^2,q^2) with q^2<=H_x(P_D)<=D*q^2;
- on M_rel>B^(1/12-eta), C_D>B^(1/12-eta) and H_x(P_D)>B^(1/6-2*eta).


Not promoted:
M3_T11_X_MINUS_ONE_EIGHTH_ACTIVE_D_SUPPORT_DEFICIT_PROVED=false
M3_T11_X_MINUS_ONE_EIGHTH_POWER_SAVING_PROVED=false
M3_T11_PRIMARY_GATE_CLOSED=false
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false


2. M3-T11-081 — Sophie-Germain residual kernel: PASS


On the primitive x=-1/8 conic,
a=(r^2-2*s^2)/epsilon,
b=2*r*s/epsilon,
c=(r^2+2*s^2)/epsilon,
with gcd(r,s)=1 and epsilon in {1,2} according to the primitive parity normalization.


Direct expansion gives
epsilon^2*(a^2+b^2)=r^4+4*s^4
=(r^2-2*r*s+2*s^2)*(r^2+2*r*s+2*s^2).


Hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-080 supplies
D=sf(N_u/M_rel^2)=sf(N_u),
gcd(D,M_rel)=1,
with N_u=a^2+b^2.


Write
N_u=D*q^2,
q=M_rel*h,
h>=1.
Then with
W=epsilon*q=epsilon*M_rel*h,
one has exactly
F(r,s)=D*W^2.


This is a valid same-measure router to one fixed decomposable binary quartic with an actual square-divisor witness. No determinant-density or ambient squarefree-value saving follows.


3. M3-T11-081 — distinguished negative-square point: PASS


Define
alpha=2*r*s/W,
beta=(r^2-2*s^2)/W,
gamma=(r^2+2*s^2)/W.


Because W=epsilon*q,
alpha=b/q,
beta=a/q,
gamma=c/q.


The conic identities imply
gamma^2-alpha^2=D,
gamma^2-beta^2=2*alpha^2.


Thus
P_D=(X,Y)=(-alpha^2,alpha*beta*gamma)
satisfies
X+D=beta^2,
X-D=-gamma^2,
and therefore
Y^2=X*(X+D)*(X-D)=X^3-D^2*X.


On the nondegenerate physical carrier alpha*beta*gamma is nonzero, so Y is nonzero and the point is not rational 2-torsion. Hence every realized positive squarefree D is a congruent number in the standard elliptic-curve sense.


The sign pattern
X=-square,
X+D=+square,
X-D=-square
is the claimed distinguished negative-square 2-descent pattern.


No density consequence is promoted from the word "congruent number".


4. M3-T11-082 — explicit moving-twist point: PASS


Using the same primitive physical coordinates,
N_u=a^2+b^2=D*q^2,
c^2=a^2+2*b^2,
define
P_D=(x_D,y_D)=(-b^2/q^2,a*b*c/q^3).


Then
x_D+D=a^2/q^2,
x_D-D=-c^2/q^2,
so
y_D^2=x_D*(x_D+D)*(x_D-D)
=x_D^3-D^2*x_D.


This is exactly the same rational point as in M3-T11-081 under
alpha=b/q,
beta=a/q,
gamma=c/q.


Therefore M3-T11-081 and M3-T11-082 are compatible descriptions of one point, not two independent arithmetic savings.


5. M3-T11-082 — exact standard denominator root: PASS


On the primitive x=-1/8 carrier,
gcd(a,b)=1,
a,c are odd,
b is even.
Hence N_u=a^2+b^2 is odd, so D and q are odd.


If p divides q, then p divides a^2+b^2. Since gcd(a,b)=1, p divides neither a nor b.


Modulo p,
a^2==-b^2,
and from c^2=a^2+2*b^2 one gets
c^2==b^2 mod p.
Therefore p does not divide c.


Hence
gcd(q,a*b*c)=1.


So
x_D=A_D/C_D^2,
y_D=B_D/C_D^3
with
A_D=-b^2,
B_D=a*b*c,
C_D=q
is already reduced in the integral Weierstrass model y^2=x^3-D^2*x.


Thus
C_D=q=M_rel*h,
and in particular
M_rel | C_D.


This point/standard-denominator sublemma agrees with the independent recheck already recorded inside the hostile audit of M3-T11-083.


6. M3-T11-082 — naive x-height window: PASS


For
H_x(P_D)=max(|A_D|,C_D^2),
one has exactly
H_x(P_D)=max(b^2,q^2).


Since
a^2+b^2=D*q^2
and a is nonzero on the primitive physical carrier,
b^2<D*q^2.


Therefore
q^2<=H_x(P_D)<=D*q^2.


On the hard branch
M_rel>B^(1/12-eta),
q=M_rel*h with h>=1 gives
C_D=q>B^(1/12-eta)
and
H_x(P_D)>=q^2>B^(1/6-2*eta).


These are exact lower/relative height statements. They do not by themselves imply that the moving squarefree support D is sparse.


The physical upper window required for a usable twist-counting theorem is supplied later by hostile-audit-passed M3-T11-083:
D*q^2 | L_vee*tau^2
with R=H_c*tau<=B.


7. No-double-charge and route relation: PASS


M3-T11-081 and M3-T11-082 must not be counted as two separate saving mechanisms.


M3-T11-081 contributes the Sophie-Germain quartic presentation and the distinguished squareclass pattern.
M3-T11-082 rewrites the same point in the primitive physical coordinates and exposes its exact standard denominator root and naive x-height.


Thus:
- the 081 point and 082 point are identical;
- the congruent-number label gives no independent density saving;
- q>=M_rel gives no independent density saving;
- the old M_rel^-2 determinant is not recharged;
- ambient binary-form squarefree-value density and all-points-on-all-twists counts are not substituted for the exact Stage37 physical measure.

AUDITED_CARDS=M3-T11-096

AUDIT_SCOPE=Normalized-theta exact algebra, residual-character dependence, standard rational 2-isogeny formulas, Kummer squareclasses, same-physical-measure/no-double-charge consequences, and credit boundaries.
GITHUB_ACCESSED=false


1. Executive verdict


M3-T11-096 survives hostile audit.


Promoted:
- exact normalized identity 16*L+3*kappa=M^2*Theta;
- exact normalized residue Theta == 16*(t_0/s)^2*x*(4*x-3) mod M^2;
- the M3-T11-092 residual-character lock is dependent on theta M^4 plus the normalized endpoint square on the surviving theta branch;
- the ordinary rational-2-torsion / 2-isogeny Kummer map loses the fresh M_rel^2 square factor;
- the two 2-isogeny factors are exactly the already-retained M^2 by M^2 decomposition of the theta M^4 carrier;

Not promoted:
M3_T11_DENOMINATOR_EXTREME_SUPPORT_DEFICIT_PROVED=false
M3_T11_PRIMARY_GATE_CLOSED=false
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false


No endpoint theorem and no Perfect Cuboid nonexistence credit are obtained.


2. Dependency and measure check — PASS


Dependencies M3-T11-090 through M3-T11-095 are already hostile-audit PASS under Stage37-HOSTILE-AUDIT-M3-T11-090-095-PASS.


The audited scope remains the same fixed-content/coefficient, nondegenerate generic full-S-denominator physical branch with theta!=0 and R<=B.


No population, height, field, quotient, or physical multiplicity change is introduced by M3-T11-096. The card is a redundancy/no-double-charge firewall, not a new counting theorem.


3. Normalized-theta algebra — PASS


Put
M=M_rel,
N_u=M^2*N_0,
t=M^2*t_0,
ell=M^2*L,
kappa=(v+1)/M^2=N_0/b^2,
Theta=theta/M^4.


From the audited exact definition
theta=16*ell+3*(v+1)
one gets identically
16*L+3*kappa=M^2*Theta.


Hence, in the fresh M-adic residue ring,
L == -3*kappa/16 mod M^2.


Using the audited theta factorization together with
w=M^2*omega,
omega=a*t_0/(b*s),
x=kappa/(16*omega),
one gets exactly
Theta=kappa*(kappa-12*omega+4*M^2*omega^2)/(4*v).


Modulo M^2, and using omega^2/v=t_0^2/s^2,
Theta == 16*(t_0/s)^2*x*(4*x-3) mod M^2.


At any fresh prime where Theta is a unit, the prefactor 16*(t_0/s)^2 is a square unit, so the local unit squareclass of Theta is exactly that of x*(4*x-3). This is only a router; no density or fixed-power credit follows.


4. M3-T11-092 residual-character dependence — PASS


Audited M3-T11-092 gives
W_flat^2=-N_0*Phi_flat.


Since
kappa=N_0/b^2,
we have
kappa*Phi_flat=-(W_flat/b)^2.


Combining with
L == -3*kappa/16 mod M^2
gives
